# androbeet — Archive

> Andrew's independent archive of original essays on philosophy, atheism, feminism,
> and psychology, published under the name androbeet.

Andrew is a self-taught developer, philosopher, and writer working independently.
This archive indexes his published essays (hosted on Medium) and other projects.
His related site, the androbeet Lexicon (https://androbeet.github.io/), is a
dictionary of original terminology he has coined, including Consortivulnus,
Virilnorm, and Gendarchy.

## Essays
See data/articles.json for the full, current list of titles, links, and one-line
descriptions — that file is the source of truth and is updated as new essays are
published.
